artist.name: Andi
artist.short_description: Andi — an Afterglow editorial selection for listeners exploring alternative pop.
artist.biography: Andi is an American pop performer represented by the Andi catalogue with songs such as ‘Made Up Story’, ‘Crazier Best Friend’, ‘Devil's Work’, and ‘One Man Show’. A 2022 music feature describes her as originally from New Jersey and working in Los Angeles at that time. The artist's own Linktree account connects to the same streaming profile and social channels, helping distinguish this Andi from several unrelated musicians who use a similar name. Her Apple Music catalogue includes the 2022 Runner Up project and later independent singles, while Spotify's official artist embed lists recordings across multiple years. Of particular value to Afterglow is the song ‘Devil's Work’: in contemporaneous coverage, Andi discussed her concerns about unrealistic images and insufficient openness around mental health. These are attributable artist comments about that particular song, not a universal description of her catalogue. Editorially, her music fits an alternative and confessional pop lane alongside Jessica Baio and NERIAH. Her expanded legal name should remain unverified rather than inferred solely from a social-media username.

career_milestones.description: Released Devil’s Work and Made Up Story.
Continued releasing standalone singles, including Strangers By March.
